# Editorial x Terminal

## Overview

Editorial readability meets tech log aesthetics. A magazine format with enough machine-log texture to feel technical.

Generated by web-stylebook-mcp from the fusion-editorial-terminal style. Values come from the pinned visual contract (revision fnv1a:d11eee64d085b23e). This file describes the dark theme.

Visual profile: display-cut serif headline type, ruled article and log columns, long-read magazine rhythm.

## Colors

Token names follow DESIGN.md conventions; the name in parentheses is the compose_design_tokens role.

- **primary** (text) `#f4ecd6`: Body text and headings.
- **on-primary** (textInverse) `#0a0e08`: Text on a primary (ink) fill.
- **secondary** (textMuted) `#a8a593`: Secondary text: captions, metadata, helper text.
- **surface** (canvas) `#0a0e08`: Page background.
- **surface-container** (surface) `#161b13`: Panels and cards.
- **surface-container-high** (surfaceRaised) `#161b13`: Raised surfaces such as inputs, menus, and popovers.
- **surface-variant** (surfaceMuted) `#161b13`: Muted fills such as hover rows, wells, and disabled areas.
- **outline** (borderStrong) `#f4ecd6`: Control boundaries that must stay visible.
- **outline-variant** (border) `#f4ecd64d`: Dividers and decorative rules.
- **accent** (accent) `#ffb45a`: The style's identity accent.
- **on-accent** (accentText) `#000000`: Text on the accent.
- **accent-secondary** (accentSecondary) `#161b13`: Secondary accent for selection and secondary surfaces, not the primary action.
- **on-accent-secondary** (accentSecondaryText) `#f4ecd6`: Text on the secondary accent.
- **action-primary** (actionPrimary) `#ffb45a`: Primary button fill.
- **on-action-primary** (actionPrimaryText) `#000000`: Primary button label.
- **action-secondary** (actionSecondary) `#161b13`: Secondary button fill.
- **on-action-secondary** (actionSecondaryText) `#f4ecd6`: Secondary button label.
- **link** (link) `#ffb45a`: Link text.
- **focus** (focus) `#ffb45a`: Focus indicator.

Status colors (positive, caution, critical, info) are not in this file; take them from compose_design_tokens.

## Layout

Spacing tokens: unit 4px, stack 20px, gutter 24px, row 44px, section 64px. Density: comfortable.

### Page structure

- **Opening:** The opening is the article's own first screen, not a split: a full-bleed command bar prints the release path, then the reading grid (1fr | minmax(220px,280px)) sets a lowercase mono '>' kicker, a 2.8-6rem Iowan Old Style headline in ink, and a 50ch serif lede in the column, while the margin lane already holds the release spec plate: a 24px graph-paper box with ┌ ┐ └ ┘ corner glyphs around the version number in giant serif and a blinking block cursor, over a mono dl whose last row, the live build state, is set in amber. At most one text link; the headline reads first, then the build state.
- **Grid:** A reading layout rather than a card grid: the article runs as 1fr | minmax(220px,280px) with a clamp(28px,4vw,64px) gap, its prose capped at 62ch on a flat surface fill, and sections step by 64px with clamp(40px,5vw,80px) of vertical padding. Full-bleed command bars cut between sections at the same side padding, and below 980px the margin lane drops under the article.
- **Density:** Two densities interleaved: the reading column is loose at 1.1rem/1.85 with 22px between paragraphs inside 62ch, while the chrome around it is tight, with 0.74rem command bars, 0.68rem status text, and margin-log rows at 0.74rem/1.7 on the 4px unit.
- **Type scale:** Iowan Old Style carries every reading and display role: the 2.8-6rem display at 400 and -0.025em is about five times the 1.1rem body, h2s are 500 at 1.9-2.9rem within 26ch, and section indices are 1.6rem italic serif. JetBrains Mono is confined to state, time, and chrome at 0.62-0.78rem, lowercase, prefixed with sigils ('$', '//', '#', '›').
- **Section order:**
  1. Article opening: command bar, serif headline in the reading column, the release spec plate in the margin lane
  2. Command bar naming the step, then the explanatory article with its runtime margin lane
  3. Install or migration section: serif steps, each preceded by the exact shell command it runs
  4. Changelog section: line-numbered paragraphs that reviewers can cite by line
  5. Closing build summary line and an empty prompt, beside the one link to the docs
- **Signature moves:**
  - Runtime marginalia lane: Lets checkable technical facts (versions, timings, build results) ride beside the explanation without interrupting the reading column.
  - Shell-command section dividers: Gives a docs or release page a scannable outline in which every section names the exact command behind what it explains.
  - Line-numbered serif paragraphs: Makes long explanations citable like source, so a reader can link to 'line 031' or anchor a review comment.

### Must-haves on the portfolio home

The style restyles these but never removes them; every first-screen item goes in the opening.

- **Work samples**: Anywhere on the page. Show at least 3 pieces of work, as images or as a headed list of linked projects.
- **Contact**: Anywhere on the page. Give a direct way to reach a person: an email or phone link, a contact form, or a link to the contact page.

## Shapes

Every corner is square. Borders: 1px solid.

## Components

Each component names its text color and the background it sits on.

- **body-canvas**: primary on surface — Body copy on the page
- **body-panel**: primary on surface-container — Body copy in a panel
- **muted-panel**: secondary on surface-container — Supporting copy in a panel
- **button-primary**: on-action-primary on action-primary — Primary button label
- **button-secondary**: on-action-secondary on action-secondary — Secondary button label
- **input-placeholder**: secondary on surface-container-high — Input placeholder
- **link-canvas**: link on surface — Link text
- **selection**: on-accent-secondary on accent-secondary — Selected item label
- **accent-fill**: on-accent on accent — Text on an accent fill.
- **focus-ring**: focus — Focus ring color.

Non-text pairs, which need 3:1 against their background:
- outline on surface-container-high — Essential input boundary
- focus on surface — Focus indicator adjacent to canvas
- focus on surface-container — Focus indicator adjacent to panel
- outline-variant on surface — Decorative separator, not a control boundary

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do: Replace the monospace body face with the style's authored family. (style rule typeface)
- Do: Put running text on a solid island; keep the gradient behind it, not under the words. (style rule text-on-effect)
- Don't: Centered hero over a gradient blob (pattern gradient-blob-hero)
- Don't: All-text centered stack (pattern centered-stack-hero)
- Don't: Stock-photo hero (pattern stock-photo-hero)
- Don't: Logo strip (pattern logo-strip)
- Don't: Generic “trusted by” band (pattern trusted-by-band)
- Don't: Icon feature cards (pattern icon-feature-grid)
- Don't: Testimonial carousel (pattern testimonial-carousel)
- Don't: Generic closing CTA banner (pattern closing-cta-banner)
- Don't: Generic SaaS page skeleton (pattern generic-saas-skeleton)
